payload.name: Retrieve favorite items via shared-activity and preference memories
payload.description: When a question asks for a person's favorite item with a specific attribute, and a direct search using the attribute and 'favorite' misses the memory, search the person's item-sharing and preference memories before concluding no information.
content: When a question asks for a person's favorite item with a specific attribute (e.g., a dish including garlic), do not require the attribute word or 'favorite' to appear verbatim in a memory. Run an additional hybrid search pairing the person with the item's activity/category terms (recipes, cooking, sharing meals) and inspect current versions of top results.

If a retrieved event describes the item with other descriptors and a separate memory records the person's preference for the queried attribute, use the combination as evidence instead of answering 'No information available' simply because no single memory contains all query terms.

Match the queried date against memories' structured world_start/world_end, not against the date phrase in the text; a memory whose world_start equals the queried date can be the sharing/offering event.

solves: When a question asks for a person's favorite item with an attribute, direct searches requiring the attribute word or 'favorite' can miss memories describing the item differently. The agent then answers 'No information available' despite separate evidence: an event of sharing/offering the item and a preference memory for the attribute. The rule: combine distributed event and preference evidence before concluding absence. Applies to favorite-item-with-attribute questions; not for questions without a specific attribute or direct evidence.
